In summary, our research is concerned with
the optimization of enzyme hydrolysis condition of fenugreek heteropolysacchride, and the effects of hydrolysate on the growth of probiotics.

the enzyme hydrolyzed products of fenugreek heteropolysacchrides and their effects on B. adolescentis growth,which provides a theoretical foundation for the development of new probiotics and the application of fenugreek polysaccharides.
the optimization of enzyme hydrolysis condition for the fenugreek neutral polysaccharide, and the effects of the products on Bifidobacteria reproduction.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the optimal condition for the enzyme hydro-lysis of fen-ugreek neutral hetero-poly-sac-charide was the No.5 condition(9 h reaction tim,50℃ reaction temperature and 60% enzyme content),the yield of the hydrolysis products reached to 0.92 g/L,the molecular weight of the small one was 4.5 x 10~(-4) and it had better effect on the growth of bifidobacterium.
the No. 5 scheme was the optimal condition,which had the highest yield of oligosacharide and the best effects on B. adolescentis growth.
the optimal condition of enzyme hydrolysis was 9 h reaction time,50 ℃ reaction temprature and 6%enzyme content,and its products had good effects on the growth B.adolescents.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the optimal hydrolysis conditions for the fenugreek neutral polysaccharide were determined by orthogonal test,and the products had good effects on the growth and reproduction of B.adolescencis.
the enzyme hydrolyzate of fenugreek heteropolysac-charide could be a good prebiotics and could be used as a functional food.

we have optimized the reaction condition of enzyme hydrolysis for fenugreek neutral polysaccharide,and the products of two schemes had better effects on reproduction of B.adolescensis,and we also have separated the two products by gel filtration chromatography and found that the molecular weight of small product had a good effect on the growth of bacteria.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the enzyme hydrolyzed products of fenugreek heteropolysac charide could be used as the growth factor for probiotics.
fenugreek neutral polysaccharides have a significant effect on B.adolescencis growth,which may have important implications in improving intestinal health.

fenugreek neutral heterogeneous polysaccharide can be hydrolysed to obtain oligosaccharides with different molecular weights by enzymatic hydrolysis,and the oligosaccharids have a positive effect on the growth of probiotics.
